# Lifecycle timing evidence

These fixtures transcribe the 7 October 2026 report tables for #635, #633
and #636. `current.results` retains all three real samples; `baseline.results`
repeats the table's main median three times because its raw samples are not
available. Status is functional PASS, including the rows previously labeled
SLOW by the old timing comparison. Only the 25 timed operations were in those
tables. The test helper supplies synthetic successful untimed functional rows
and a shared compatible identity; these fixtures do not claim to capture the
full original functional reports or five historical main runs.
